Base USDC-cbBTC MortgagePool 0xe93131620945a1273b48f57f453983d270b62dc7 is listed in official contract docs and current homepage describes this live pool. Full applicable non-proxy mortgagefiusdccbbtcupgraded source has exact_match runtime/creation records. Observed stablecoin is native Base USDC and contractCoin cbBTC; these are terms, not backing or availability proof.

deposit pulls caller USDC in native 6-decimal units and mints equal pool accounting tokens to receiver. claim and claimFor mint accrued yield accounting tokens, not immediate USDC; claimFor can only benefit its specified receiver. giveYield may move available USDC above inExitLine to mutable conversionVault and distributes buffered yield over up to 30 days using floor division. Mutable yieldOverwrite can redirect newly accrued yield; admin control is not admitted.

createContract size is cbBTC raw units (8 decimals), duration whole years from 1 through 30, maxPaymentPerMonth raw USDC, ref is rewards-coin recipient, not executor. It pulls caller cbBTC down payment, reserves existing pool cbBTC, mints an ownership NFT and fixes principal/fees from internal pool valuation, not an unconditional oracle price. Down payment is size/2 for <=12 years, size-size*4*duration/100 for 13..24 years, size/50 for 25..30, floored at 2000 cbBTC base units. Monthly maximum bounds floor-divided principal+fees/(duration*12), not total early repayment cost.

createContractByob requires enabled BYOB, pulls size plus down payment cbBTC from caller, fixes 18%-per-year fee calculation from checked Chainlink price and mints pool accounting tokens to caller, not USDC. Oracle checks require positive answer, <=24h age, answeredInRound and Base sequencer up with >=1h grace. BYOB was observed enabled, not a continuing guarantee.

payDownContract pulls caller USDC against a designated loan scheduled outstanding amount; it does not require NFT ownership and cannot redirect collateral or grant loan control. Only currently accrued scheduled outstanding can be paid this way. Fee fraction floors, 10% of fees mints protocol accounting tokens and remainder enters yield buffer. openDebt may revert on unsigned subtraction when prepaid ahead of schedule; admission supplies no workaround or successful-payment promise.

finishContract and earlyRepayContractInFull require caller NFT ownership. finish requires all base+fee paid, transfers NFT to pool custody and returns recorded cbBTC to caller. Early repayment pulls remaining principal plus mutable earlyrepayMultiplier percent (admin setter caps at 15), marks debt paid and invokes finish. No caller maximum early fee or deadline argument exists; NFT transfer allowance must already exist independently.

fromLineToWallet only debits caller existing mySizeWaitingForExit and returns USDC if available. Queue creation burnToGetOutInLine is ADMIN_ROLE-only and excluded, so this is not a complete permissionless redemption path. Token transfers/permits/roles/admin, arbitrary multicall, conversion-vault bookkeeping and third-party default enforcement are excluded. Missed-payment default can forfeit reserved collateral; pricing, defaults and conversion-vault behavior remain protocol risks.
